cards.body:
## Summary
One learner's Essay Master paragraph is on the next learner's TV. The landing and the recap each try to hide this with a guess. Make the paragraph travel with its learner, as Math Buddy's work already does, and both guesses go.

## Description
Math Buddy's work is seat-scoped: MathsSlot (store.ts:305) is swapped by seat() when a learner sits down, and late results go to the learner they belong to (toAway). Essay Master's paragraph, its chosen lens and the sentence it is on are not in the slot, and learner.set (store.ts:451) clears the conversation, the level check and the sentence analysis but not them. Reproduced: Ema's essay.set, then learner.set jakub, leaves state.essay set, and keys.lensStops then offers Jakub the 'last' card, which EssayTV draws as 'Last verdict' with Ema's summary.

The desk papered over it in two places with two different heuristics: landingRows.essayWaiting decides a paragraph is the learner's if their history holds a reading through a lens of that name, and recapRows.ownReading does the same with an extra condition. Both pass when the second learner has read the same lens, so the very case they exist for is the one they miss. A reading that finishes after a switch has the same flaw in the other direction: analyse/route.ts dispatches essay.set with no owner.

The move: essay, essayType and essayAt join the slot, so seating a learner swaps them like a practice set; essay.type and essay.set take an optional owner, the route stamps it from the learner who asked, and an owner who is no longer at the desk gets the reading in away[owner] without the TV being sent to their forensic page. The two heuristics then read s.essay and nothing else.

## Flow
- Ema reads a paragraph through the Argument lens; the TV goes to her forensic page.
- She picks Someone else and chooses Jakub: the paragraph goes into away.ema, Jakub's Essay Master home has four lenses and no 'last' card, and the landing's Essay Master card is his own reading or two words.
- Ema comes back: her paragraph, lens and sentence are where she left them.
- Ema asks for a reading, the desk is handed to Jakub while it thinks: the reading lands in away.ema, the TV stays on the landing, nothing of hers appears for him.

## Expected impact
A shared family desk (Family Phase 1 puts two learners on one TV) stops showing one child's essay verdict to another, on the lens home, the landing card and the recap. Two copies of an ownership heuristic become none, so the next screen that reads the paragraph (the phone, a week digest) cannot get it wrong. The persisted session gains three optional keys per away slot and nothing else.

## Evaluation
Claim: Essay Master's paragraph is seat-scoped like Math Buddy's work, and no consumer needs a heuristic to know whose it is.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass for the cases that are not GUARDs (cases 1-4, 6-8 fail; case 5 is a GUARD, green by design)
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - acceptance cases written as failing tests first
Result: better
Gate: contract

Sites that decide ownership of s.essay: landingRows.ts:143-146 (label match), recapRows.ts:148-152 (label match plus sentences), keys.ts:110 and EssayTV.tsx:112-114 (no test at all) = 4 sites, 3 behaviours. The essay-master rider scout may reach the lens-home half of this; the landing half (two guards that retire) is why it is filed here.

cards.body:
## Summary
The landing says 'Continue as Ema' and then opens Math Buddy's front door. Make Select open the thing that is waiting: the marked sheet, the set on paper, the snapped page, the paragraph Ema was reading.

## Description
The desk already knows what each app has waiting (landingRows.deskWaiting) and the caption already names it ('Two-step equations, 3 of 4 right. The marked set is still on the desk.'). Select ignores that and opens MODULE_HOME: Math Buddy's Tonight, where the first stop is a continue card for the same set and a second Select opens it; Essay Master's lens home with the lamp on the first lens, not the lens Ema read. Recap's Select and Tonight's continue card both already know how to open the waiting thing, in two copies of the same branch; the landing is the one place that has the answer on screen and does not use it.

The move is one helper in keys.ts, openWaiting(s, app), that returns the events for an app's waiting thing: Math Buddy through continueCard (sheet, practice or page), Essay Master to the forensic page when the paragraph on the desk is the learner's, otherwise to the lens home with the lamp on the lens last read, and everything else (nothing waiting, Linga, whose home leads with its own Carry on) to the home as today. The landing, Tonight's continue card and the recap all call it, so there is one place that says what resuming means. No new words on the TV: the caption already carries the sentence.

## Flow
- Ema comes back to a marked set. The lamp rests on Math Buddy; the caption says it is still on the desk. Select: the hand-off plays and the sheet opens on the first slip. Back is Tonight, then the desk.
- Ema was reading the Argument lens. Select on Essay Master opens her paragraph's forensic page, or, with no paragraph in the session, the lens home with the lamp on Argument.
- Nothing is waiting, or the app is Linga: Select opens the front door exactly as before.

## Expected impact
The most common return path (the landing to the thing you left) loses one screen and one press for Math Buddy, and Essay Master stops dropping the learner on the wrong lens. The label 'Continue as Ema' becomes true. Three copies of 'open what an app has waiting' become one with a test that pins them equal, so a later change to Tonight's continue card cannot make the landing and the recap disagree.

## Evaluation
Claim: Select on the app in the light opens what the caption says is waiting, through one helper that Tonight and the recap share.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass for the non-GUARD cases (cases 1-6 and 8 fail; case 7 is a GUARD, green by design)
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - acceptance cases written as failing tests first, plus one live journey
Result: better
Gate: none
